name: @lambdasafe/pi-extensions
description: Lambdasafe Pi extensions: workspace-swarm (HTTP group chat / agent bus per workspace), ringfence (default-deny guardrail around the workspace, with optional decision-model judging of shell commands), ask-jev (fast predicate/choice/score judgements from a local LM Studio decision model over many files) and self-propagate (agent-authored context self-compaction with persistent KV working memory, /propagate and /keep-awake).

scripts.test: node extensions/ringfence.test.mjs && node extensions/ringfence.jev.test.mjs && node extensions/ask-jev.test.mjs && node extensions/workspace-swarm.test.mjs && node extensions/workspace-swarm.wake.test.mjs && node extensions/workspace-swarm.failover.test.mjs && node extensions/self-propagate.test.mjs
